C1389.title: Mirai Creators Plead Guilty and Assist FBI in Cybercrime Investigations
C1389.summary: Sentencing materials in 2018 show that the three Mirai botnet creators, Paras Jha, Josiah White, and Dalton Norman, avoided prison after developing and operating Mirai and hijacking large numbers of IoT devices for DDoS attacks, partly because they provided extraordinary cooperation to law enforcement. Details such as their December 2017 guilty pleas or assistance in Kelihos or Memcached DDoS investigations should be supported with original Justice Department or court announcements if included.
